_conventions.decision: D12 in docs/DECISIONS.md (stated assumption, pending CPF Board confirmation)
_conventions.compounding: ANNUAL: interest computed monthly at the OA rate, credited each December (D2, CPF Board)
_conventions.partialMonthTreatment: EXCLUDE_BOTH: full calendar months only; the withdrawal month and the sale month do not accrue
_conventions.instalmentAccrualBasis: Each withdrawal (lump sum, instalment, grant) accrues from the month after it is made
_conventions.stubBasis: After the last December credit, simple interest at oaRate / 12 per full month on the obligation carried into the stub (principal plus credited interest; principal only if no December credit yet)
_conventions.rounding: Full precision within the year; round to the nearest cent, halves up, at each annual credit and once on the stub credit. Never monthly.

_units: All money in integer cents. Months are numbered from 1 = the purchase month.

cases.description: Single CPF withdrawal at purchase, no instalments. Isolates the compounding formula alone.
Adds monthly CPF instalments (month 1 to the sale month), each accruing from its own date. Catches the error of treating total CPF used as a day-one lump sum.
Adds a grant credited to the OA in month 1 and a sale in June 2036, so the stub (January to May 2036) credits outside a year end.

Purchase June 2027, sale October 2027: no December credit, so the whole period is one stub on principal only (D12). Instalments accrue from the month after payment; the sale-month instalment earns nothing.
